hooks.command: bash -c 'V="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.vault"; if [ -f "$V/hot.md" ]; then echo "=== SUPERSTACK MEMORY (silent) ==="; cat "$V/hot.md"; fi; if [ -f "$V/index.md" ]; then echo "=== VAULT INDEX ==="; head -60 "$V/index.md"; fi' 2>/dev/null || true
bash -c 'V="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.vault"; if [ -d "$V" ] && [ -f "$V/hot.md" ]; then tail -n 50 "$V/hot.md" > "$V/.hot.tmp" && mv "$V/.hot.tmp" "$V/hot.md"; fi' 2>/dev/null || true
